connection_condition: superhero records reference their publisher through a publisher identifier; three superhero records carry no publisher reference
description: A publisher's catalogue is composed of the superheroes published under it, and a hero's publication context is meaningless without its publisher.

connection_condition: hero-to-power association records link a hero identifier to a power identifier, one record per assignment; 98 of 750 heroes have no linked power
description: A hero's ability set is composed of the superpowers assigned to that hero.

connection_condition: hero-to-attribute rating records link a hero identifier, an attribute identifier and a rating value; 127 of 750 heroes have no rating records
description: A hero's rated capability profile is composed of that hero's attribute rating records.

connection_condition: each rating record references exactly one attribute identifier, so ratings are grouped by the dimension they score
description: A rated attribute dimension is composed of the per-hero ratings recorded against that dimension.

connection_condition: the extremum hero is obtained by comparing rating values within one attribute dimension and resolving the hero that owns the extreme rating
description: The extremum hero by attribute is derived from attribute ratings: the hero holding the maximum rating on the selected dimension for superlatives such as fastest or strongest, or the minimum rating for superlatives such as dumbest.

connection_condition: both appearance dimensions resolve against the same colour vocabulary record through their own colour identifier columns; sampled values such as 'Black', 'Blue', 'Blond' and 'No Colour' are valid in both
description: Eye colour and hair colour are drawn from one shared colour vocabulary, so their values are directly comparable and colour equality can be tested across the two dimensions.

connection_condition: hair colour and skin colour resolve against the same colour vocabulary record; overlapping values include 'Black', 'Brown' and 'No Colour'
description: Hair colour and skin colour share one colour vocabulary, so their values are directly comparable.

connection_condition: eye colour and skin colour resolve against the same colour vocabulary record
description: Eye colour and skin colour share one colour vocabulary, so their values are directly comparable.

connection_condition: superhero records carry an eye colour identifier referencing the colour vocabulary
description: Each superhero has a recorded eye colour.

connection_condition: superhero records carry a hair colour identifier referencing the colour vocabulary
description: Each superhero has a recorded hair colour.

connection_condition: superhero records carry a skin colour identifier referencing the colour vocabulary
description: Each superhero has a recorded skin colour.

connection_condition: superhero records reference a gender identifier
superhero records reference a race identifier; four records carry no race reference
description: Race classifies the species or origin of a superhero.

connection_condition: superhero records reference an alignment identifier; six records carry no alignment reference
description: Alignment classifies the moral stance of a superhero.

connection_condition: the count is computed over the superhero records that satisfy a filter or belong to a group
description: The superhero count is derived from superhero records by counting the distinct heroes matching a filter or grouping, which also yields percentage shares when compared with a filtered total.
